sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Anand Mohan Pandey,Ram Raj Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned Additional Government Advocate for the State of U.P. and perused the record.
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant seeking bail in Case Crime No.289 of 2021, under Sections 420, 406, 504, 506 of IPC, Police Station- Sungarhi, District- Pilibhit.
As per the prosecution story, it is alleged that the applicant along with other co-accused persons is said to have deceived the first informant in the name of investment of their money in a company.
Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Further submission is that the applicant has not caused the alleged incident.
It is further stated that there is no criminal history of the applicant except the present case.

It is further submitted that the the applicant has already been enlarged on bail in similarly situated matters by another Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 23.12.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 51724 of 2022 and 51767 of 2022 respectively.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 51724 of 2022 and 51767 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Copies of the bail orders have been brought on record as annexure 3 to the bail application.

There is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future due to Bhagirath Verma vs State Of U.P. on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60720090/
1 heavy dockets.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that there is no apprehension that after being released on bail, he may flee from the course of law or may, otherwise, misuse the liberty of bail and the applicant is in jail since 28.04.2022 and the possibility of conclusion of trial in near future is very bleak.
Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail, but he has not disputed the above contention made by the learned counsel for the applicant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, perusing the record and also considering the nature of allegations, arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and keeping in mind that the applicant has already been released on bail in similarly situated matters by this Court and without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I find it to be a fit case for granting bail.

Let the applicant, Bhagirath Verma, involved in above mentioned case crime number be released on bail on their executing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence.
(ii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity.
(iii) The applicant shall not threaten the informant and witnesses and further shall cooperate in the investigation.
(iv) The applicant will appear regularly on each and every date fixed by the trial court unless his personal appearance is exempted through counsel by the court concerned.
In the event of breach of any of the aforesaid conditions, the learned court below will take recourse to law of cancellation of bail of the applicant.
Order Date :- 20.1.2023
